entities.name: C0M8J5 undecaprenyl-diphosphatase
observations: Reviewed Streptococcus equi subsp. equi protein; query sequence matches the reference exactly across 279 residues.
Annotated as an undecaprenyl-diphosphatase (EC 3.6.1.27), membrane-localized; reported to confer bacitracin resistance.
